Docs lab

One Docs, several sources: the architecture model (a worked example in the AIToolbox ArchiMate notation: Catalogue, LikeC4 views by TOGAF phase, Process), an AI wiki written by the community (tips, procedures, news), operational procedures (release, organisation, incidents, design system) and the new joiner path. Everything is visual, and everything can be asked through the Knowledge base. Search and questions go through the header’s search bar only; going back is a subheader. Way in A · Spaces is adopted; B and C stay for the record. Press Play.

Process

Changes

Each change is a work package. It goes through four steps before it reaches its plateau.

1
DecideAn ADR per significant choice, in model/adr. Accepted ones are never edited.
2
DesignThe ASD for the board, the detailed design in each service repository.
3
ReviewThe ARB: checks run on every build, reviewers decide, recorded in Git.
4
DeliverThe work package closes its gap and reaches the next plateau.

SweepEnvsDocsCommunity
Way in · A adopted
  • ASpaces · four spaces, each with its own picture: views, a learning path, a release train, a checklist. Adopted 30 OctOne entry for everyone; the architecture space opens on Catalogue, Views and Process. Also in the production vision.
  • BApplication lens · pick an application and see its view, design, procedures and decisions together. Not adopted, kept for the record: best for architects and leads; weaker for the AI wiki and onboarding, which belong to no application.
  • CAsk first · suggested questions are the page; the header’s search bar asks, and answers come back as pictures with their sources. Not adopted, kept for the record: fast for people who know what they want; hides what exists from people who do not. Asking stays in the header for everyone.
One knowledge base, seven sources
  • ARCHArchitecture model · LikeC4 and Markdown in the central repository · one document per element, plus graph tools
  • DDDetailed design · Markdown in each application repository · one document per section
  • APIContracts · OpenAPI and AsyncAPI · one document per operation
  • AIAI wiki · community pages: tips, procedures, news · one document per section
  • OPSProcedures · doc site · one document per section
  • NEWNew joiner · doc site, plus your access from the directory
  • GLOGlossary · domain reference · one document per term
Rules
  • Pictures are generated from a model or from Markdown. No fact lives only in a picture, so the assistant can answer it from the header’s search bar.
  • Every answer lists its sources (id or path) and the version: plateau, commit, date.
  • A source inferred from code is a draft until an architect authors it, and answers say so.
  • The docs are never edited from here: Propose a change opens a pull request.
  • The frame takes the height of the screen (up to 1080 px in this lab), so Administration and Cookie policy stay at the bottom of the rail.
